systems.country_label: Projecto de Inovação em Segurança Pública, segunda fase
systems.platform: CCTV, vehicle-tracking (VTS) and emergency systems on 524.8 km of fibre
systems.owner: National Police; financed by the Export-Import Bank of Korea, USD 87 million
systems.tiers: five centres to be built in the Luanda municipalities of Cacuaco, Talatona, Viana, Kilamba Kiaxi and Cazenga, begun February 2026, due 2028

note: Police command centres and cameras in Luanda's municipalities; the fibre is the police's, and no local government office is said to be on it.
